name: Weeping Ring
body:
Price 9,000 gp; Aura faint enchantment; CL 5; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring is made of a dark, dull metal that seems to be streaked with dried salt, when activated tears drip from the ring and the quiet sounds of crying can be heard.

The wearer can touch a target and impose a -3 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, and skill checks for 5 rounds. The wearer of the ring takes a -1 penalty to the same rolls for the same duration as the target. This is an emotion and mind-affecting effect.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,500 gp; Feats Forge Ring, ray of sorrow
